public_rationale: Marcus forecast that in 2026 home humanoids like Optimus and Figure would be 'all demo and very little product.' The window ends on 2026-12-31, after the evaluation date. My searches found plans and targets, not documented mass delivery to homes. Tesla talked of consumer sales by late 2026 or 2027. Figure talked of leasing to homes. 1X planned 2026 shipments of NEO, with early units partly teleoperated. Nothing found meets the early-contradiction rule of thousands of units in regular home use. But a late-2026 rollout could still change the picture, so it is not yet settled.
limitations: 'Very little product' has no number attached, so the final call needs judgment.
Many search results were low-authority aggregators, and I did not cite them.

from_speaker: Human domestic robots like Optimus and Figure
will be all demo and very little product
our_interpretation: The forecast covers calendar 2026 (the post lists predictions 'for 2026').

Plain reading: by the end of 2026, humanoid home robots such as Tesla Optimus and Figure will be shown mostly in demos, with few units actually sold or delivered to ordinary consumers' homes for regular use.
Other home humanoids (for example 1X NEO) fall under 'like Optimus and Figure' and are relevant, but Optimus and Figure are the named examples.

Early resolution rule: contradicted early if, before 2026-12-31, reliable sources document thousands of humanoid robots of this kind delivered into consumer homes for regular use. Support can only be judged at the end of 2026.
criteria.support_condition: By 2026-12-31, consumer home deliveries of Optimus, Figure and similar humanoids are absent or tiny (pilot or early-access scale), while demos are plentiful.
criteria.contradiction_condition: During 2026, reliable sources document a substantial product: thousands of humanoid robots sold and delivered to consumer homes and used there regularly.
